source.span: Complete Palladius I.V.3, Pinguem sic agnosces through iudicio saporis explores.
source.latin_text: Pinguem sic agnosces. Glebam paruulam dulci aqua consparges et subiges: si glutinosa est et adhaeret, constat illi inesse pinguedinem. Item scrobe effossa et repleta, si superauerit terra, pinguis est, si defuerit, exilis, si conuenerit aequata, mediocris. Dulcendo autem cognoscitur, si ex ea parte agri, quae magis displicet, glebam fictili uase dulci aqua madefactam iudicio saporis explores.

types_and_execution.ambient: FIELD denotes the discussed field supplied by the source context; it is an explicit coded leaf each time used, not a hidden variable value chosen from target. FRESH_WATER retains the predecessor encoding convention for dulci aqua.
types_and_execution.bindings: LET(name,value,body) introduces one lexical scoped entity. C1:CLOD, P1:PIT, E1:EARTH, R1:REGION, C2:CLOD, V1:VESSEL are six distinct reference atoms. FIELD is ambient. C1 and C2 must differ. Every later reference must resolve to its matching active LET; no nearest-type replacement or omitted argument is permitted.
types_and_execution.operations: SAMPLE(CLOD,owner) produces a new clod from owner; SMALL qualifies that introduced clod. DIG(FIELD) produces P1. EARTH_FROM(P1) binds E1 as the earth removed from that pit. REFILL(E1,P1) returns that same earth. VESSEL(EARTHEN) produces an earthen vessel, PLACE_IN(C2,V1) installs the sample, and TASTE(C2) is legal only after that sample has been moistened and placed in its bound vessel. All sequential side effects preserve identity.
types_and_execution.observations: OBSERVE(STICKY,C1) and OBSERVE(ADHERES,C1) are two independent sensor inputs obtained after SPRINKLE and KNEAD. Operations do not hardcode their truth. IF(AND(...),ATTRIB(C1,FATNESS)) executes the consequent only if both are true; failed conjunction emits no fatness assertion and invents no negative soil category.
types_and_execution.comparison: VOLUME(E1) and CAPACITY(P1) are numeric test inputs attached to the same returned earth and excavated pit. COMPARE(x,y) computes GREATER/LESS/EQUAL from ordinary ordering. CASE3 dispatches to exactly one written ATTRIB. The source supplies no measured values and no unit scale; boundary tests may use normalized representatives2/1,1/2,1/1 without claiming they are written numbers.
types_and_execution.taste: SELECT(FIELD,COMPARATIVELY_DISPLEASING) takes an explicit region-selection argument satisfying a declared comparative displeasure relation. It does not assert a unique maximum. TASTE(C2) returns an external sensory observation with sample identity; JUDGE_BY(SWEETNESS,observation) records a judgment/evidence pair, not the assertion that the soil is sweet. There is no invented sweetness threshold.
types_and_execution.recognition: RECOGNIZE(property,body) denotes a procedure for judging that property and executes the body when invoked. ALSO retains the explicit additional pit method. Methods are instructional procedures, not claims that all sensors returned positive values.
types_and_execution.no_hidden_outputs: The executor receives sensor booleans, pit measures, region selection and taste observation as explicit environment inputs. It may not receive FATNESS/LEANNESS/MODERATE as precomputed branch inputs. Output classes occur only as written consequent constants.

corrections_relative_to459: TASTE now has exactly one explicit sample argument, with containing vessel obtained only from the prior explicit PLACE_IN action; this is one shared state rule and a disclosed source-model convention, not an accidental arity mismatch.
IF retains the clod conjunction as an actual guard; it is no longer an unguarded INFER.
EARTHEN is an actual VESSEL argument and therefore must be written by the code.
magis displicet is comparative selection, not a total unique MAX.
OBSERVE and TASTE remain external inputs; no physical outcomes are derived merely by naming an operation.
The source gives no numerical measures. Returned volume/pit capacity formalize surplus/deficit/equal level, retaining that modeling assumption.
No redundant output-event reference names are introduced. Each real entity and every operative argument remains represented.
